about: The secreta of the formulary “Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Accept, O Lord, the sacrifice of salvation which we offer You on the feast of the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary; and grant that as we profess that she was kept from all taint of evil, by Your anticipating grace, so, through her intercession, may we be freed from all sin. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
